plain.li: The rod took that one, right where it should.
Better the rod than the roof.
That one hit the rod and nothing else.
I felt the ground jump when it hit the rod.
The rod's earning its keep today.
A tornado crossed our land today. I've never heard a wind like it, and I hope I never do again.
The tornado has passed. It sounded like a herd running over the roof, and then it was gone.
We saw the tornado coming a long way off. There was nothing to do but get inside and wait.
After the tornado the whole colony went quiet for a while, as if nobody wanted to be the first to speak.
[old] I've lived through a lot of weather, but that tornado is the worst I've seen.
Make it stop, please.
I'm going inside until this is over.
Every time it flashes I forget to breathe.
I can't remember the last time it rained.
The ground's so dry it's splitting open.
Even the weeds are giving up in this.
I've forgotten what dry ground feels like.
Everything's wet, the wood, the beds, the boots, all of it.
It's warmer than it has any right to be this time of year.
It's warm enough to work without a coat.
Those clouds are going to sit on us for a while.
The sun won't be out much longer, the cloud's coming.
There's a brown wall on the horizon, get things covered.
Dust storm coming, close everything up.
Don't ask me about the weather again.
I'll leave the forecasting to someone else.
I killed {NAME} today, the leader of the pack. I hope the rest of them keep their distance now.
The pack's leader is dead. I watched the others break and run, and I didn't go after them.
I'll be telling the story of {NAME} for a long time, the {KIND} that led the pack.
With {NAME} dead, I think the pack will leave us alone.
My hands haven't stopped shaking since I brought down {NAME}.
I'm glad {NAME} is dead, and I'm a little sorry too. It was only doing what a pack's leader does.
{NAME} is one of ours now. I keep going out to look at it, to make sure it's real.
People told stories about {NAME} for years. Now it sleeps on our land.
It took so long to earn {NAME}'s trust. I don't mean to waste it.
I still can't quite believe {NAME} chose to trust me.
The towns around here will hear that {NAME} lives with us now. I wonder what they'll make of it.
I'll look after {NAME} as well as I can. It deserves that much.
{NAME} is dead, and I'm the one who killed it. I don't think it's sunk in yet.
They'll tell stories about {NAME} for a long time yet, and now I'm in them.
I keep seeing the moment {NAME} fell. It was bigger up close than anyone said.
Everyone wants to hear about {NAME}. All I want is to sleep.
I'm proud of bringing down {NAME}, and I'm not ashamed to say so.
There was a moment when I thought {NAME} would kill me instead. I won't forget it.
{X_nameDef} is free as of today. I didn't know what to feel, so I went back to work.
The council let {X_nameDef} go. I hope they're right, and I hope I never see {X_objective} again.
{X_nameDef} is gone. I keep looking toward the gate as if {X_pronoun} might come back.
I wanted {X_nameDef} punished. The council wanted it finished. Maybe they're wiser than me.
They released {X_nameDef} today. It's over, at least as far as the council is concerned.
I don't forgive {X_nameDef}. I'll just have to live with what the council chose.
{PET_nameDef} put itself between me and the fight without a moment's thought. I'll never forget it.
{PET_nameDef} deserves the best of everything after today.
[hurt] I'm hurt, but it would have been far worse without {PET_nameDef}.
[day:foot] {PET_nameDef} slept at the foot of my bed last night. It was warm, and I slept well.
[day:foot] I found {PET_nameDef} curled up at the end of my bed when I woke.
[day:foot] {PET_nameDef} chose my room to sleep in last night. I didn't have the heart to move {PET_objective}.
[day:foot] Last night {PET_nameDef} came in and settled at my feet, and stayed till morning.
[day:foot] I could hear {PET_nameDef} breathing at the foot of the bed all night. It was a comfort.
[killed] {VICTIM} is dead because of {X_nameDef}. I've sworn it won't happen to anyone else.
[maimed] I saw what {X_nameDef} did to {VICTIM}. I've sworn the beast won't do it again.
I've sworn to hunt down {X_nameDef}, and I meant every word.
I'll find {X_nameDef}. It might take a season, but I'll find it.
I can't rest while {X_nameDef} is still out there, so I've sworn not to.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} remembered {DEAD} together, and the little habits it had.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} that {A_pronoun} still looks for {DEAD} at feeding time.
{A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} whether {B_pronoun} would ever want another like {DEAD}.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} agreed that the place hasn't been the same without {DEAD}.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about the day {DEAD} first came to the colony.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued over which of the herd looks most like the first foal.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} who was there when the first foal was born.
{A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} whether {B_pronoun} had ever seen a foal born before that one.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about how much the herd has grown since the first foal.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} how nervous everyone was the day the first foal was coming.
